# Suede Docs

> Public documentation for Suede: programmable IP, creator ownership, and agent-ready media commerce for the AI era. The canonical, most current source is the GitHub README at github.com/Suede-AI/suede-docs; this page (docs.suedeai.ai) mirrors its key facts.

Suede (https://suedeai.ai) builds creator-ownership infrastructure for AI-native media. Suede was formerly known as Suede AI and Suede Labs. The public docs cover programmable IP, provenance, rights metadata, licensing workflows, and x402 and ACP discovery surfaces. AI music is one implementation area, not the whole product.

## Docs

- [Full text of this site](https://docs.suedeai.ai/llms-full.txt): Every docs.suedeai.ai page as one Markdown file, generated from the pages, for assistants that want the complete text in one fetch.
- [Suede Docs: canonical README](https://github.com/Suede-AI/suede-docs): Public doc set with core pillars, product directory, x402 and ACP guidance, token references, profiles, and language guidance.
- [Live agent-commerce catalog](https://app.suedeai.ai/api/v1/catalog): Current public product availability and pricing in a schema.org ItemList response.
- [x402 discovery document](https://app.suedeai.ai/.well-known/x402): Machine-readable x402 routes published by the live app surface.
- [suede-sdk-python](https://github.com/Suede-AI/suede-sdk-python): Python SDK (`pip install suede-ai`) wrapping Suede's x402 endpoints as typed client methods.
- [suede-token](https://github.com/Suede-AI/suede-token): $SUEDE token contracts and chain references.
- [suede-creator-skills](https://github.com/JasonColapietro/suede-creator-skills): Free public agent-workflow skills for creators.

## API guides

Checked against the live API on 2026-10-11; prices, payment terms, routes and response codes rechecked on 2026-11-25. Prices and request fields come from the discovery documents on app.suedeai.ai. The quickstart, endpoints, errors, Python SDK and discovery guides each end with a short FAQ.

- [x402 quickstart](https://docs.suedeai.ai/quickstart): Pay a Suede endpoint over x402: read the 402 challenge, sign an EIP-3009 USDC authorization on Base, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, then poll the job.
- [Endpoints](https://docs.suedeai.ai/endpoints): The three pay-per-call endpoints with prices, USDC amounts, shared payment terms, request headers, asynchronous mode, which endpoint fits which job, the smallest valid request for each, the two poll shapes and batch budgeting.
- [Create Music](https://docs.suedeai.ai/endpoints/create-music): POST /create-music, a full original song from a text prompt, $0.50 USDC on Base.
- [Agent Video](https://docs.suedeai.ai/endpoints/agent-video): POST /agent/video, an 8-second 720p clip with native audio, $4.99 USDC on Base.
- [Agent Image](https://docs.suedeai.ai/endpoints/agent-image): POST /agent/image, one PNG or JPEG, $0.15 USDC on Base.
- [Errors and limits](https://docs.suedeai.ai/errors): Status codes, error bodies, rate-limit headers, idempotency keys, versioning, and which requests are never charged.
- [Python SDK](https://docs.suedeai.ai/python-sdk): The suede-ai package on PyPI: install, client options, methods, how it pays, and polling.
- [Discovery and MCP](https://docs.suedeai.ai/discovery): The x402 manifest, OpenAPI 3.1 spec, product catalog, A2A agent card, Agentic Commerce manifest and MCP server.

## Notes

Long-form notes by Jason Colapietro, founder of Suede in West Palm Beach, Florida. Published 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-15, updated 2026-11-15; the notes index was updated 2026-11-25.

Suede ranks among Clutch's Top 30 AI Consultants in Florida (https://clutch.co/consulting/ai/florida) and Top 50 AI Consultants nationwide (https://clutch.co/us/consulting/ai) (November 2026). Clutch profile: https://clutch.co/profile/suede-ai-seo

- [Notes index](https://docs.suedeai.ai/notes): All notes from the Suede team on developer docs, MCP and AI search, with a guide to which note to read first for your work.
- [Writing developer docs that AI assistants quote correctly](https://docs.suedeai.ai/notes/ai-quotable-developer-docs): The source, date and verification rules behind this site, and how a Palm Beach County business can apply them.
- [Model Context Protocol for agencies](https://docs.suedeai.ai/notes/mcp-for-agencies-south-florida): A South Florida primer built around the live Suede MCP server, with scoping rules and tradeoffs.
- [From open source to docs](https://docs.suedeai.ai/notes/open-source-to-docs): Lessons from 54 merged pull requests across 46 open-source repositories, applied to developer documentation.
- [An API documentation checklist for agency-built integrations](https://docs.suedeai.ai/notes/api-docs-checklist-agency-integrations): Seven groups of checks (auth, captured examples, errors, idempotency, versioning, OpenAPI, ownership) for agencies in West Palm Beach and Jupiter that hand off client integrations.
- [Writing llms.txt that answer engines actually use](https://docs.suedeai.ai/notes/llms-txt-worked-example): A section-by-section walk through this file, with the guards that keep it current and three checks for whether anything reads yours.

## Ecosystem

- [Suede](https://suedeai.ai): Main product site with product, blog, and company information.
- [Suede Universe Map](https://map.suedeai.ai): Plain-English directory of public Suede sites, apps, and endpoints.
- [Jason Colapietro profile](https://suedeai.ai/founder): Public leadership profile on the main Suede site.
- [suedeai.org](https://suedeai.org): Thesis, books, and investor information.
- [AI Agent Builder & Workflow Automation](https://suedeai.app): Build AI agents visually for leads, invoices and reports. Test workflows, inspect every run, and publish paid x402 APIs when payments are enabled.
- [Suede ACP/x402 Performance Engine](https://perform.suedeai.ai): Score your ACP/x402 readiness in 60 seconds. Free, no account required.
- [Agentix: x402 AI Agent Earnings Tracker for USDC on Base](https://agentix.suedeai.ai): The portfolio tracker for the x402 agents you've launched. Total USDC earned on Base, calls, per-agent performance, status, and trend.

## Optional

- [Suede IP Registry](https://registry.suedeai.ai): The ID and trust layer for music: one verifiable public ID per work, with a wallet-signed creator claim, contributors, timestamp, and derivative links on Base and Avalanche.
- [Suede agency](https://suedeai.agency): Suede's West Palm Beach SEO, GEO and web development practice serving Jupiter and Palm Beach County.
- [Suede SEO](https://suedeai.ai/seo): GEO, PR and reputation practice covering how a business appears across AI answer and search surfaces.
